topic: Content stored before SP-023 has no placement
detail: Chunks written before SP-023 carry no origin, space or labels_v, and a migration copies them as they are. A docs file whose content and repo HEAD did not change, and a source file whose text did not change, is not written again, so it keeps no placement (or an earlier one) until 'orch rag relabel' (SP-027); a repo whose visibility flips without a new HEAD is not re-stamped (SP-030.1.a2). Repo visibility and owner node ID are recorded on chunks only, not in docs_repos (no migration added, to keep parallel lanes rebase-friendly). Readers must treat a missing space or stale labels_v as unreadable (INV-08, SP-025/SP-027).
